Targ. Jud. XVI, 29; a. e., v. מִיצָּעָא.—Fem. מְצִיעֵיתָא, מְצִיעֲתָא.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 6:6">Targ. I Kings VI, 6</cite> <he>מציעי׳</he> ed. Lag.; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 6:8">ib. 8</cite>.—
B. Bath. 107ᵃ מילתא מציעתא it is the average (between twenty and thirty).—Esp. מציעתא the middle clause of a Mishnah &c., contrad. to רישא first clause, and סיפא the ending clause.
